entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I was a bit nervous when you told[n]me to come to the jazz club...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It ain't as bad as I thought! I feel like I went[n]up the stairs to adulthood again...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Boss, I'll take the usual! Heheh, nah, as if.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Thanks for inviting me today, man.[n]I feel refreshed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa, hehe. It's a lot later than I thought.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: See ya later!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The noise, the smell...[n]This is definitely a place for adults.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Nyahaha, perfect for a gentleman[n]like me!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even though I'm always with you,[n]it feels different when I'm with you here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We were here for quite some time.[n]I appreciate you bringing me here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmm, we should probably head home.[n]We wouldn't want to get caught.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, let's head home.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wow! So this is how it looks in here![n]It's like a hideout for adults!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Your room's pretty neat too, but this[n]isn't bad either!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Maybe it's the mood of the place, but I[n]feel like I became a little more mature...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh! I didn't realize it was this late.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, let's go home!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: See you next time!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I thought we were entering a[n]catacomb, but... this is not bad at all.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I feel it! I feel the inspiration flowing[n]in me! Hahahaha! I'm not going to be[n]sleeping tonight!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If possible, I'd like to draw at this very[n]location... I bet I could create an amazing[n]piece.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Apologies for taking up a lot of time,[n]but I appreciate you bringing me here.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It looks like it's time to head home.[n]Hmhm. That was an evening well spent.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: See you around.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To think you know places like this too...[n]It's simply amazing...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: O-Oh. I suppose it would be rude[n]of me to look around while there're[n]so many people here...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was nervous at first, but strangely[n]enough, it calms you down.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank you for inviting me today. It was[n]really fun.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, look at the time. We should get going.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Good bye for now.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This is quite a calming place.[n]The atmosphere here is so warm.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you for inviting me.[n]I'm pretty excited for the drinks.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: After walking down the stairs, they[n]end up in the mysterious jazz club[n]once again... Heheh, just kidding!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you, I had so much fun.[n]I hope you invite me here again.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Perhaps it's time to go home. We[n]were here a lot longer than I expected.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Well, goodbye for now!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: N-No way! This is impossible![n]I'm super nervous right now!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But at the same time, I'm kinda hyped![n]It's like a dungeon in here!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There's a lot of hype underground.[n]This is getting real good!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I enjoyed the jazz club![n]Geez, I can't tell you how nervous I was.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But it ended up being pretty fun.[n]Let's go home, [fName]!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Now, I'll just make like a dog and go[n]back home!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm so happy that I'm here talking with[n]you again. Isn't this jazz club nice?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I like how not a lot of people really know[n]this place... Heh, or does that sound like[n]I'm showing off?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This place is like your house. It's not the[n]greatest, but you still end up feeling so[n]comfortable.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The time I spend with you is so meaningful.[n]Oh, and there's something else I wanted to[n]talk to you about...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Ah, sorry. It looks like I have to get[n]to work. Time flies when you have[n]fun, doesn't it?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: See you next time.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Senpai, you're so mature, coming to jazz[n]clubs and all.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Is it difficult to um, order by yourself? Or...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Thank you so much for inviting me[n]today. I had so much I wanted to talk[n]to you about.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: It was so fun today![n]I hope you invite me here again.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Shall we head home? It's getting a[n]little late.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: See you, Senpai.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Even at times like this... This place is no[n]different.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So, you had something you wanted to talk[n]about? I'll talk to you if you need me to.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What, you like this place that much?[n]I guess I understand how you feel.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That wasn't too bad.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Guess it's time.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, see ya.
